subject: VantageCloud partner readiness: sandbox interop & tech validation
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex@vantagecloud.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner sandbox access and test plan

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking this on. VantageCloud is ready to run a technical validation of the Redwood reference integration. We're targeting a limited partner pilot covering 1) model inferencing via Redwood Private, 2) webhook-based callbacks to our event bus, and 3) SSO+mTLS for the control plane.

I've attached a short network diagram and a baseline sandbox account (credentials shared via secure link). Primary goals:
- Validate end-to-end reference flow (token exchange -> inference -> postback)
- Exercise KV/prefix caching with 8k sequence loads
- Measure P50/P95 latency at 10 TPS sustained

Can you confirm Redwood's recommended test cases and whether your team can run the interop test matrix the week of Nov 1? Anna from BrightForge (our systems integrator) will coordinate lab time and scripts.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Monroe
Head of Partnerships
VantageCloud

Hi team —

I've uploaded the interop-test-plan.xlsx (tabbed: test-cases, infra-reqs, success-criteria). Highlights and Redwood acceptance criteria:
- Latency: P50 < 60ms, P95 < 180ms for 8k tokens under 10 TPS (measured at edge gateway)
- Correctness: top-3 exact-match for determinism tests (seeded prompts)
- Stability: no memory leakage across 6-hour sustained run (KV cache stress)
- Security: mTLS handshake success rate > 99.9%; token rotation tested

Test cases I'll own for: prefix caching, fallback routing, quantized model variant (int8). Markus will handle cert exchange + network verification. Alex — can BrightForge provide the test harness (JMeter scripts or a simple Python harness)? If so we'll convert to our metrics collector format.

Next: we'll finalize the matrix and share a readout doc after the Nov 3 run.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
